# Junte-se a este projeto de ciência cidadã para estudar as formigas ao seu redor!

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

library(readxl)
data <- read_excel("map/sampling_points_AH.xlsx")

library(dplyr)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))

library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)

# Asegurarse de que lat/lon son numéricos y válidos
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
    longitude = as.numeric(longitude)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))

# Crear el mapa con puntos por grupo "PRO" y "KIDS"
map <- leaflet(data) %>%
  addTiles() %>%
  setView(lat = 36, lng = -6, zoom = 5) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.PositronNoLabels, group = "Street Map") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  
  # Puntos PRO
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = filter(data, version == "PRO"),
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    label = ~paste("Sampling site:", code, "Type:", type),
    popup = ~paste(
      "<strong>Sampling site:</strong>", code, "<br>",
      "<strong>Type:</strong>", type, "<br>",
      "<strong>Latitude:</strong>", latitude, "<br>",
      "<strong>Longitude:</strong>", longitude, "<br>",
      "<strong>Version:</strong>", version
    ),
    radius = 4,
    color = "#B22222",
    fillOpacity = 0.6,
    stroke = FALSE,
    group = "Ant Hunters PRO"
  ) %>%
  
  # Puntos KIDS
  addCircleMarkers(
    data = filter(data, version == "KIDS"),
    lng = ~longitude,
    lat = ~latitude,
    label = ~paste("Sampling site:", code, "Type:", type),
    popup = ~paste(
      "<strong>Sampling site:</strong>", code, "<br>",
      "<strong>Type:</strong>", type, "<br>",
      "<strong>Latitude:</strong>", latitude, "<br>",
      "<strong>Longitude:</strong>", longitude, "<br>",
      "<strong>Version:</strong>", version
    ),
    radius = 4,
    color = "#FFA500",
    fillOpacity = 0.7,
    stroke = FALSE,
    group = "Ant Hunters KIDS"
  ) %>%
  
  # Añadir leyenda
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomright",
    colors = c("#B22222", NA, "#FFA500"),
    labels = c("Ant Hunters PRO", " ", "Ant Hunters KIDS"),
    title = "",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  
  # Control de capas base y de los grupos de puntos
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Street Map", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = c("Ant Hunters PRO", "Ant Hunters KIDS"),
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  )

# Mostrar el mapa
map


```
